scope: Engineering screening stop rules, not owner acceptance of regressions or a production performance certificate

primary.rule: Retain prior historical ceilings and upper paired block 95% CI below 1 for original/candidate p50 and p99 in each primary workload; do not weaken the prior ten-block by 10000 acceptance rule

warm_screen.order: alternating AB/BA, stable pair_id and exact revisions recorded before execution

primary.historical_scope: Same-machine System comparisons only; allocator/partition-shape changes must be disclosed; historical ceilings cannot certify mimalloc or substitute for a matched baseline.

append_and_cold_rotating_compressed_othe.comparison: candidate versus same-allocator unchanged control; inconclusive is not a pass

rss_object_bytes_object_operations.zero_control_rule: any positive excess requires explanation and remains unaccepted

additional_controls.retained_plaintext: Unique backing capacity charged once per admitted owner must remain within the existing requested/max-page allowance or the existing oversized-first-record allowance; selecting a subset must not hide retained storage. Charge must survive result/body retention and return to baseline on last drop.
additional_controls.cache: Carve storage, metadata, fills and retained-reader charges from existing read-cache allowance; no increase to the total configured budget. Fix explicit global and tenant sublimits before running the prototype; do not choose them from timing results.
additional_controls.cold_samples: At least 1000 process/cold-state observations per case before any cold p99 statement; otherwise report individual observations/median/max only and leave cold tails unaccepted
additional_controls.offered_load: Preserve scheduled-arrival queueing, full-body completion and explicit failures; persistent-connection controls must remain separate from the existing connection-close workload

candidate_cache_geometry_before_cache_me.budget_source: carved out of HISTORY_CACHE_BYTES; default off; no increase to configured total
candidate_cache_geometry_before_cache_me.status: predeclared design limits; validate actual metadata geometry before implementation activation

transport_diagnostic.server_spans: request-correlated optional nested durations; not additive and not primary uninstrumented latency
